stages.title: Free market failure and the mixed economy
stages.sub: Why pure free markets fail in some areas, and the advantages and disadvantages of the state stepping in to correct this.

steps.q: A firm would build a lighthouse only by charging ships, but they can't be stopped from using the light. Will any firm build it?
steps.right: No, firms will not provide it
steps.wrong: Yes, firms will still provide it
steps.hint: Think about whether the firm can actually collect payment from every ship that benefits.

steps.q: A government funds the lighthouse itself, while shops still freely trade bread and clothes as normal. Does the market still allocate most goods?
steps.right: Yes, the market still allocates most goods
steps.wrong: No, the state now allocates most goods

steps.right: Yes, it has limited the worst outcome
steps.wrong: No, it has not changed the outcome
